description: This PHP source file defines the ElastiCacheClient class within the Aws\ElastiCache namespace. It serves as a client for interacting with Amazon ElastiCache service, providing methods corresponding to various API operations, with support for both synchronous and asynchronous calls. The class extends the AwsClient base class and includes method annotations for client capabilities.

classes.name: ElastiCacheClient
classes.description: A client class used to interact with Amazon ElastiCache, extending the AwsClient base class, with methods for managing cache clusters, parameter groups, replication, snapshots, and related operations, supporting both synchronous and asynchronous calls.
